answer.exemplar: A straight prop leaning against the wall would press on it at an angle and could push the wall outwards, transferring the very thrust the buttress is meant to remove. questions.explanation: A straight prop pushes on the wall instead of carrying the thrust away. A raking arch keeps the thrust in compression down its curve into the outer pier, delivering the force into the pier, not the wall.
questions.hint: Think about where the thrust line runs.
